# CLAUDE.local.md — toolkit wiring (generated by init-project.sh)

## Wiring — single source of truth for all paths (agents read THIS block, not per-agent copies)

Every subagent resolves project paths from here. Keep it correct; refresh after a toolkit pull with
`/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/bin/sync-project.sh`. Paths below are the toolkit conventions — **confirm each exists
at build time and correct any that differ**; a path that doesn't resolve is a wiring failure the
`build-ready` gate will catch.

| Key | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Toolkit root | `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit` | The process authority |
| Toolkit commit | see `PROJECT.md` `Toolkit commit:` | Authoritative there; ritual keeps it fresh |
| Project MPR | `app/erpv1.mpr` | The model file — two-tree layout (`mxcli new --output-dir app`, build-plan row 2); not created until Stage 5 |
| MDL source dir | `mdlsource/` | Numbered build scripts |
| Module briefs | `architecture/modules/<Module>/` | one `module-brief.md` per module |
| Wireframes | `design/wireframes/` | one annotated HTML per screen |
| Design system | `design/ds.css` + `design/design-system.html` | tokens + component showcase |
| StyleGallery MDL | `mdlsource/gallery/` | or "not built yet" |
| Architecture | `architecture/blueprint.md` | blueprint + fit-gap |
| Build plan | `architecture/build-plan.md` | numbered, dependency-ordered |
| Business rules | `analysis/<source>/knowledge-base/` | BRDs (`F<NNN>.brd.json`) |
| UI review reports | `design/ui-reviews/` | `ui-review-<date>.html` (`module-review.md`) |

## Session-start ritual (main session only, before any pipeline work)

A dispatched helper skips this section: its brief is its starting position. For the main
session, your memory of the toolkit's rules is stale by default:

1. `git -C /root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit pull --ff-only`. If `git -C /root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit branch --show-current` isn't
   `master`, or the pull could not fast-forward, say so before trusting the clone (a stale
   branch re-stamped a rule master had replaced, 2026-09-16).
2. `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/bin/status.sh <project-root> --brief` — post its three lines as the session's
   first message. They are the position of record, never your memory of last session.
3. If it reports toolkit updates available, run `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/bin/gate-check.sh <project-root>` and
   follow its notice: show the user what changed, ask, record the ack only on a yes. Staleness
   never blocks a gate.
4. State in chat which commit you're working from.

## The toolkit is the process authority

This project uses the shared toolkit at `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit`. For ANY pipeline work
(analysis, BRDs, architecture, design, build plan, build, test, cutover):

1. **Read `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/skills/conversion-runbook.md` §1b plus your own stage's section FIRST —
   every session; not the whole file** (`bin/gate-check.sh <project-root> <stage>` prints the line
   spans). It is the executable spec. The toolkit README and toolkit-guide.html are orientation only; stage
   summaries anywhere are routing, not deliverable lists.
2. **Before producing any stage artifact, open that stage's owning skill** and follow its
   full output list (e.g. Stage 3 design work = `design-artifacts.md`, incl. one wireframe
   per screen — not just a design system).
3. **Every gate question is asked in chat, then the turn ends and waits** (runbook §1).
   `ASSUMED` is earned by asking — the user said "you decide" — never by skipping.
4. **Before calling a stage done:** `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/bin/gate-check.sh <project-root> <stage>`.
5. **Before any page MDL:** read `/root/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit/skills/ui-preflight-pages.md` in full — its
   *text*; a delegated page draft carries the text or reads the file first. **After it:** the
   `check-page-shell`, `page-fidelity` and `ui-loop` rows below, then look at the page at
   1280px and 390px and write what you saw to `design/ui-reviews/` — a 100% fidelity score
   once matched under half its wireframe (2026-09-19).
